Discriminating evidence: 25% without ethylene glycol, 8% under Ar, 0% without Fe or hydrosilane; SI S16 secondary allyl imine competing nonmigrated, SI S13 no crossover, SI S14 PhSiD3 label; gram scale 24mmol 80%. All Fe oxidation states beyond isolated controls remain proposed.
manuscriptScience.retrospective: List IDPi/PFTB geranyl selective cationic cyclization. Distinguish catalyst ee control from fluoroalcohol-modulated initial α/γ and γ→α isomerization. SI S2–S4 time/resubjection, SI S5–S6 NMR titrations, 1.3 apparent PFTB order, KIE3.45 not direct proof of PFTB proton donation, DFT async bond formation and enantiomeric ΔΔG‡1.4 kcal/mol; 1q no reaction, 1p 56%/84:16, squalene43%.
